payload.title: THR2 original binary DRAT archive shard 3 of5
payload.body:
# Original THR2 binary DRAT certificate archive shard 3 of5

This artifact-check REVIEW preserves 6 exact original compressed portions in this shard. All five shards together reconstruct26 original proof-data files (150385201bytes), including four originals exceeding the single-file8MiB budget. Part and original hashes, offsets, original checksum bindings and source/data provenance are explicit.

Complete bounded binaryDRAT format parsing covers591782656decodedbytes/19902204records. This is structural archival screening, not RAT/UNSAT verification or P versus NP proof acceptance. No solver, proof checker or original research code was run; no proof was newly generated. Canonical numeric text was only hashed in memory and is not an existing/original exported file. Actual solver identity and replay environment are not independently reconstructed. Four named MCSP/THR2 historical inputs remain bounded-not-found.

Original human/AI roles and explicit own-data CC BY4.0 grant apply; the new byte-reassembly helper is Apache2. Quoted source words and external solver libraries/binaries retain their rights.
